_comment: Dynamic regions per screen. `selectors` are evaluated against the rendered fixture and their boxes mask both images; a selector may add `heading` (text of the picked element's first h1-h3) and `inner` (descendants to mask inside the picked elements). `rects` are fixed boxes in reference-frame coordinates. Only data that legitimately varies (counts, times, names, identifiers) may be listed. Navigation, tabs, headings, card bounds, tables, buttons and chips are never masked. Rects marked mock-only annotation cover captions the handoff mocks print on the image itself (the Proposed design footer, the DESIGN CONCEPT label, sample-policy and recovery-flow captions); they are not product UI and are masked on both images.
